svg.text: Text, images, audio and video in. Cited answers out.

g.text: PDF, image, audio or video is sent to the FastAPI backend
File type decides which modality pipeline runs
MiniLM for text, CLIP for images, Whisper transcripts for audio
Vectors go to ChromaDB, entities and links go to Neo4j
Vector similarity and graph traversal are combined
Groq LLM streams a reply with source citations
